subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

A few students have __condemned__ the latest project of preparing teaching aids as a waste of money.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Applauded**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"condemned"** means to express complete disapproval of something, typically in public; it implies criticism or denunciation. (निंदा करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The council condemned the building for being unsafe and ordered its demolition.
 
 
 
• **"Applauded"** refers to expressing approval or praise for something, often through clapping or verbal appreciation. It is the opposite of "condemned." (प्रशंसा करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The audience applauded the singer for her outstanding performance.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **"condemned"** is **"applauded."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Applauded**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Contradicted** (विरोध करना): To deny the truth of something by asserting the opposite.

 
 
• **Example:** The witness contradicted the defendant's alibi during the trial.
 
 
 
• **Doomed** (अभिशप्त): Certain to fail, suffer, or experience an unfortunate outcome.
 
 
• **Example:** The mission was doomed from the start due to poor planning.
 
 
 
• **Consolidated** (मजबूत करना): To make something stronger or more solid.
 
 
• **Example:** The two companies consolidated their operations to improve efficiency.

The correct answer is: **Option 4**.
